title: Bonoan: Estrada had at least P7.4-B congressional initiatives in 2025
summary: Suspended Senator Jinggoy Estrada had at least P7.4 billion in congressional initiatives in 2025, according to former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan.
